summary: Frontend-only verification of Egypt package detail page (round-5 changes). Tested at desktop 1440 and mobile 390. All required assertions pass EXCEPT one 'Plan for free' string violation in the reviews CTA.

ui_bugs.issue: CTA text still reads 'Plan for free now' — violates requirement 'CTA text everywhere is Customise this trip (no Plan for free)'. Present at both 390 and 1440.

verified_pass: Desktop 1440: 0 console errors, no horizontal overflow, eg-breadcrumb visible, eg-gallery-desktop visible, eg-gallery-mobile hidden

Mobile 390: 0 console errors, no horizontal overflow (0px), eg-breadcrumb NOT visible, eg-gallery-mobile visible with 5 children, scrollWidth 1790 > clientWidth 358 (swipeable), eg-gallery-count = '5', eg-gallery-desktop hidden

Lightbox BUG FIX: clicking eg-gallery-button opens eg-lightbox with naturalWidth=1080 and counter '1/5'; eg-lightbox-next advances to '2/5'; close via Escape works; clicking eg-gallery-image-2 opens lightbox at '3/5'
Header facts: eg-detail-days '11 days' and eg-detail-cities '5 cities' share same top y=513 (desktop) / 505 (mobile); eg-detail-tags (Culture/Honeymoon/Luxury) is on a lower row (y=561 / 553)

eg-detail-route-block visible with eg-detail-route-code 'Route code: EG-CAI-ASW-LXR-HRG-CAI · 11D' and eg-detail-route-line containing 6 city chips in order: Cairo → Aswan → Edfu → Luxor → Hurghada → Cairo (rendered as SPAN pills separated by SVG chevrons; individual chips do not carry per-chip data-testid but visually correct)
eg-detail-price-cta and eg-sticky-cta read 'Customise this trip'; sticky CTA height = 56px (≥56); sticky price '₹1,44,000' font-size = 22px (≥20)

Itinerary: eg-route-summary-cta shows 'Tour summary' at 390 and 'View tour summary' at 1440 (responsive spans, other hidden with display:none); eg-route-section-1 eg-route-subtitle contains chips Aswan/Edfu/Luxor; eg-route-bullet computed font-size = 16px
Activity/accommodation clamp: sampled 5 eg-activity-card descriptions — webkitLineClamp = 'none', scrollHeight === clientHeight (not clipped). 15 activity cards, 5 accommodation cards found.

eg-detail-experts ('Why plan with our experts?') visible at both 390 and 1440 in the main column, below eg-detail-route (experts_top 5457 > route_top 906 desktop; 6586 > 1425 mobile). eg-detail-sidebar does NOT contain the experts card.

Regression: Route summary CTA scrolls to 'The route at a glance' table (5 rows visible in screenshot); hotel 'View photos (3)' buttons present with eg-accommodation-photos testid; listing /afrika/aegypten loads with 0 console errors and 'per person' string appears 6 times on cards
action_items: Change reviews CTA copy from 'Plan for free now' to 'Customise this trip' in EgyptDetail.jsx (data-testid='eg-reviews-cta') to satisfy the 'no Plan for free anywhere' requirement.
critical_code_review_comments: Route line city chips inside eg-detail-route-line lack per-chip data-testid attributes — assertions targeting eg-detail-route-city* would fail. Consider adding data-testid to each chip if tests rely on them.
eg-route-summary-cta uses two nested spans (one for each label) with responsive display toggling — works, but consider a single element with responsive classes for cleaner DOM.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All round-5 detail-page requirements verified except reviews CTA text still says 'Plan for free now'. After fix, re-verify body has zero occurrences of 'Plan for free' at both 390 and 1440.
